decisions.reason: As a lower-visibility accessory with limited public commitment and only indirect relevance to the firm's main digital-growth direction, several years of weak or unclear market presence make withdrawal the more likely choice.
Its link to digital dental workflows and the firm's earlier visible commitment still encourage management to continue rather than openly reverse course, even if market traction appears mixed.
Because this custom earmold line sits close to the firm's core custom-manufacturing capabilities and hearing-care channels, accumulated investment and strategic fit favor continued support.
